[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (lst: List Int) : Int :=
match lst with
| [] => 0
| h1 :: h2 :: t =>
  if h2 % 2 = 1 then
    h2 + implementation t
  else
    implementation t
| _ => 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation lst
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  by_cases h_lst_non_empty: lst ≠ []
